finds.title: Core Power Protein Sampling at Union Station — November 18–19
finds.summary: Visit the Core Power by fairlife sampling activation at Union Station's York Kiosk on November 18–19, noon–8 PM. Samples subject to availability.
finds.description: Stop by Union Station's York Kiosk on November 18 or 19, from 12 PM to 8 PM, for a Core Power protein drink sampling activation. Samples are available while supplies last.
finds.howToClaim: Visit the York Kiosk inside Union Station during the scheduled sampling hours. Ask staff about available samples.
finds.restrictions: Sampling is not guaranteed. Product formats, flavours, quantities, eligibility and limits are determined by the operator; supplies may run out early. This listing covers November 18–19 only.

finds.title: Burger King Whopper Swap Pop-Up at STACKT
finds.summary: Visit Burger King's Whopper Swap truck at STACKT on November 26 from noon for activities and a Whopper coupon opportunity.
finds.description: Head to STACKT Market's West Lawn on November 26 from 12 PM for Burger King's Whopper Swap pop-up. Take part in activities and pick up a Whopper coupon to redeem in store. Check the coupon for full terms.
finds.howToClaim: Visit STACKT Market's West Lawn from noon on November 26 and ask the promotional team about coupon availability.
finds.restrictions: A free burger is NOT confirmed. Coupon value, eligibility, redemption terms and closing time have not been published. End date is a date-only placeholder, not a confirmed closing hour.

finds.title: Blue Mountain Resort Winter Pop-Up at STACKT
finds.summary: Free Blue Mountain Resort winter activation at STACKT on November 28 from 11 AM, with photo opportunities and advertised swag.
finds.description: Get a taste of winter at Blue Mountain Resort's pop-up at STACKT Market on November 28! Visit the Lookout from 11 AM for a chalet-inspired photo opportunity and a chance to pick up promotional swag while supplies last.
finds.howToClaim: Visit the Lookout at STACKT Market starting at 11 AM on November 28.
finds.restrictions: Swag availability, quantities and eligibility are not published or guaranteed. The event closing time is not confirmed; 11:59 PM is a date-only expiry placeholder, not the advertised operating time.

finds.title: Kreate Market Holiday Market at STACKT — November 21–22
finds.summary: Free-admission holiday market at STACKT November 21–22, noon–8 PM daily, featuring local makers and seasonal shopping.
finds.description: Get into the holiday spirit at Kreate Market's Holiday Market at STACKT Market! Explore local vendors, shop handmade gifts and unique finds, and enjoy festive shopping in Toronto. Visit November 21–22, from 12 PM to 8 PM daily. Admission is free; check the event page for registration details.
finds.howToClaim: Check the organizer's free Eventbrite registration page before visiting. Admission is advertised as free.
finds.restrictions: Shopping, food and merchandise purchases cost extra. Registration is advertised by the organizer; confirm entry requirements and availability on the ticket page. Event organizers may photograph or film visitors.
